PBGC design system reference

Version 1.1.0. One file, no dependencies, no network calls. Built from tokens/tokens.json and src/styles/components.css.

The PBGC style guide defines no dark theme. The dark theme here is provisional and must not ship without COLA approval.

Color tokens

Ratios are computed at build time against white. Source: PBGC Branding and Editorial Style Guide, September 2025.

Typography

Arial is the universal brand font, Helvetica Neue is preferred on Mac, Garamond is secondary. No web fonts are loaded.

Heading 3, 22px bold

Lead paragraph, 18px. Line length is capped at 60 characters per the style guide.

Body text, 16px (12 pt). PBGC protects the retirement security of about 31 million American workers, retirees, and beneficiaries in both single-employer and multiemployer private sector pension plans.

Garamond long-form, 20px, for fact sheets and reports.

Contrast

Every semantic color pair is validated by npm run tokens in both themes. The build fails if any pair drops below its WCAG minimum. See tokens/contrast-report.md for all 59 checks.
